headline: Chiefs' Patrick Mahomes earns 100th win in 131st start, tying Tom Brady
summary: Quarterback Patrick Mahomes earned his 100th win with the Chiefs in his 131st regular-season start Sunday, tying Tom Brady for the fewest games needed to reach 100 career wins.

headline: Kicker Chad Ryland accounts for all of Cardinals' points in upset of Rams
summary: Chad Ryland kicked six field goals, including a game-winning 43-yarder as time expired, to lift Arizona to an 18-16 win over the Rams.

headline: Josh Allen ties Jim Kelly's Bills TD pass record as Buffalo holds off Raiders 33-30
summary: — Jim Kelly set the standard for every Bills quarterback, but even the Hall of Famer likely wouldn't have made the type of play Josh Allen pulled off Sunday.

headline: Caleb Williams leads Bears by Falcons in return from injury
summary: Caleb Williams completed 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards and a TD and showed no physical limitations from the injury he suffered Sept. 20.

headline: Harbaugh mum on McDaniel, says Chargers need 'to address everything'
summary: Jim Harbaugh said his Chargers will "have to address everything, and especially offensively" after another dismal performance in a 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

headline: Jordan Love, Green Bay's defense lead the way in Packers' 23-13 victory over Cowboys
summary: — Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love didn’t bother wondering what might have been.
